description: Non-thesis sectors for startups that fail thesis alignment but come from legitimate sources. These keep rows in the output instead of dropping them.

expanded_sectors.name: AI & Enterprise Software
expanded_sectors.description: General AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, workflow automation, SaaS platforms not specific to supply chain or manufacturing

expanded_sectors.name: FinTech & Payments
expanded_sectors.description: Financial technology, payment processing, lending, insurance tech, accounting, and compliance — excluding trade finance and supply chain finance which belong to the thesis

expanded_sectors.name: Climate & Energy
expanded_sectors.description: Clean energy, carbon tracking, sustainability, ESG, mining, materials, batteries, EV infrastructure — excluding agtech which belongs to the thesis

expanded_sectors.name: Health & Life Sciences
expanded_sectors.description: Healthcare, biotech, medtech, pharma, digital health, mental health, wellness

expanded_sectors.name: Consumer, Media & Other
expanded_sectors.description: Consumer products, marketing tech, edtech, legal tech, HR tech, real estate, gaming, media, and anything else that doesn't fit the above four expanded sectors or the thesis sectors

classification_rules.description: Always attempt thesis sector match first. Only fall back to expanded sectors if no thesis keyword/tag matches. If no expanded sector matches either, assign EXP-TIC (catch-all).
